title: Score-Based Stochastic Closure Modeling via Offline Indirect Learning and Online Data Assimilation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stochastic closure modeling is an emerging area in reduced-order modeling of large and complex (e.g., multiscale, multi-physics) systems, for which the computationally affordable reduced-order physical descriptions (e.g., digital twins for additive manufacturing, world models for AI agents) in numerical simulations inevitably lead to information losses that cannot be well addressed by classical deterministic closures. However, learning stochastic closures typically requires closure data that are difficult to obtain from measurements or often prohibitively expensive to compute using first-principles simulations. In this work, we develop a stochastic closure modeling framework that builds on score-based diffusion models, leveraging indirect offline training and online data assimilation without requiring the direct data of closures. translated_title: 基于分数的随机闭合建模：通过离线间接学习与在线数据同化实现
translated_abstract: 随机闭合建模是大型复杂系统（如多尺度、多物理场系统）降阶建模中的一个新兴领域。在数值模拟中，计算上可负担的降阶物理描述（如增材制造的数字孪生、AI智能体的世界模型）不可避免地导致信息损失，而经典的确定性闭合方法无法很好地解决这一问题。然而，学习随机闭合通常需要闭合数据，这些数据难以从实际测量中获得，或者使用第一性原理模拟进行计算的成本往往过高。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个基于分数扩散模型的随机闭合建模框架，利用间接离线训练和在线数据同化，而无需闭合的直接数据。在二维湍流上的数值实验表明，间接离线学习能够捕获……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于分数扩散模型的随机闭合建模框架，通过离线间接学习与在线数据同化相结合，无需获取难以获得的直接闭合数据，即可有效解决复杂多尺度系统降阶建模中的信息损失问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a score-based diffusion model framework for stochastic closure modeling that combines indirect offline learning with online data assimilation, enabling effective closure for complex multiscale systems without requiring hard-to-obtain direct closure data.
